seo_title: Boats for Sale in Ottawa, IL | Quest Watersports
seo_description: New, used and brokered boats at Quest Watersports, next to Heritage Harbor on the Illinois River. Call 815.433.2200 for current boat inventory in Ottawa, IL.
body_html:
There is something magical about being on the water. It relaxes you, brings friends and family together, stirs up fun and creates memories. At Quest Watersports we live, work and play on the water, and we are here to help you do the same in the heart of Starved Rock Country.

Find Your Boat

Our boat inventory changes often. For current new, used and brokered boats, call us at 815.433.2200 or use the contact form below and tell us what you are looking for. We will send you what is available and set up a time to see it at the dealership next to Heritage Harbor Ottawa.

Looking to move up or move on? Sell or trade your boat with us.

Trailers, Parts and Boating Supplies

  • Boat trailers
  • Heritage Harbor boating supplies

More Than a Boat Dealer

Marine Service and Parts

We get you back on the water fast and at fair prices. Our technicians work on virtually every watercraft, motor and trailer make and model, and we stock a substantial parts inventory. If we do not have it, we can get it fast. See service and parts.

Quest Express Boat Club

Imagine your choice of premium boats, whenever you like, with no boat loan, no maintenance and no storage or trailering. Choose a boat online, pick a time, and it is ready and waiting at the marina. Learn about the Quest Express Boat Club.

Storage and Off-Season Care

Winterizing, inside and outside storage, shrinkwrap and spring relaunch. See boat storage and our boat valet service.

Financing

Affordable financing for boats, motors and trailers through respected lending partners. See financing options.

Starved Rock Country and Heritage Harbor

Starved Rock Country is the best place in northern Illinois for outdoor adventure, and historic Ottawa is the perfect jumping-off point. Heritage Harbor is a resort community built around a vibrant marina on the Illinois River. Read about Starved Rock Country, boating the Illinois River, or visit Heritage Harbor Ottawa.

Visit us at 1851 N 2871st Road, Ottawa, IL 61350, or see our hours and directions.
